blind.description: A rectangular, freestanding slab or wall segment carved to resemble stratified rock. It has solid, continuous geometry with subtle stylized chiseled bevels and cracks. The texture features hand-painted stylized earth tones: brown-grey rock with diagonal striations, a horizontal band of lighter tan stone across the upper half, and mossy dark green coverage at the base. It stands directly on its own flat bottom without an added base or plinth. No detached parts, melted elements, or emissive glowing sections.
blind.from_above: A simple narrow rectangular top face of a wall with slightly rounded/chipped edges, textured in light yellowish-brown stone.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 6.5 ft tall), and about 3.5 ft wide by 1.2 ft thick.
